name: refurbished-iphone-prices
title: Refurbished iPhone prices
description: Entry prices of refurbished iPhone models, observed twice a day on the French, American, German and Spanish Back Market storefronts and kept as a dated time series.

resources.name: latest
resources.title: Most recent observation of each model, per market

fields.name: observed_at
fields.title: Observation timestamp
fields.description: When the price was read, in UTC with second precision.

fields.name: market
fields.title: Market
fields.description: Storefront the price was read on. Markets are independent series and are never converted into one another.

fields.name: model_id
fields.title: Model identifier
fields.description: Stable slug for the model, identical across markets, suitable as a join key.

fields.name: model
fields.title: Model name
fields.description: Model name as displayed by the source.

fields.name: price
fields.title: Entry price
fields.description: Cheapest offer visible for this model at that moment, in the market's own currency. Not the price of a specific unit: storage and cosmetic grade can raise the amount at checkout.

fields.name: currency
fields.title: Currency
fields.description: ISO 4217 code, always the currency of the market.

fields.name: reference_new_price
fields.title: Reference new price
fields.description: New price for the same model as displayed by the source. Empty when the model is no longer sold new. Read, never estimated.
